command.label: Command word. Anyone can type it alone, or with list, to show the panel. Mods use it with the words below.

whoCanManage.label: Who can add, remove and adjust

verbAdd.label: Word to add a goal (!incentive add 15 chat confessions)

verbRemove.label: Word to remove a goal, by number or part of its name

verbSubs.label: Word to adjust the sub count (+3, -2, set 12)

verbBits.label: Word to add bits from somewhere else (+500)

verbTip.label: Word to add a tip from somewhere else (5 or 12.50)

verbReset.label: Word to zero the count and re-open every goal

verbStart.label: Word to start tracking subs and bits

verbStop.label: Word to stop tracking subs and bits

countNewSubs.label: Count new subs, resubs and Prime subs (one each)

countGifts.label: Count gifted subs (a gift bomb counts its full size once)

startTracking.label: Start with tracking on (first load only; after that use the start and stop words)

bitsPerSub.label: Bits that count as one sub (leftover bits carry over; 0 switches bits off)

showBits.label: Animate bits and tips being cheered and turning into subs

bitsCalcSeconds.label: Seconds the bits bar takes to calculate: the bar fills and the number counts up over this long (longer is calmer)

bitsStripSeconds.label: Seconds the bits strip stays on screen once the bar has finished

bitsLabel.label: Word for bits in the strip (+300 bits)

tipsPerSub.label: Tip amount, in your channel's currency, that counts as one sub (leftover carries over; 0 switches tips off)

tipSymbol.label: Currency symbol shown in the strip (a blank shows none)

maxVisible.label: Most upcoming goals shown at once (the nearest ones win)

keepUnlocked.label: Keep reached goals on screen (untick to remove them after the celebration)

unlockSeconds.label: Seconds a reached goal celebrates before it settles

showWaitingCounts.label: Show the target beside goals that are waiting their turn

maxNameLength.label: Longest goal name allowed, in characters (longer is cut off when added)

unlockedText.label: Text while a goal is celebrating

doneText.label: Text beside a goal that has been reached, on the right (include any dash you want)

pausedText.label: Note shown beside the sub count while tracking is stopped

themePreset.label: Style preset (pick Custom to use your own colours and font below)

fontFamily.label: Font (used when the style preset is Custom)

title.label: Title text above the goals (leave blank for none)

showTotal.label: Show the running sub count beside the title

headingScale.label: Size of the title and the sub count, which are always the same size (compared with the text size)

pausedScale.label: Size of the paused note beside the sub count, compared with the count (1 is the same size)

titleOwnFont.label: Use a different font for the title (tick, then pick it below)

titleFont.label: Font for the title (only used when the box above is ticked)

totalOwnFont.label: Use a different font for the sub count (tick, then pick it below)

totalFont.label: Font for the sub count (only used when the box above is ticked)

panelOpacity.label: Panel opacity (0 is invisible, 1 is solid) (used when the style preset is Custom)

paddingV.label: Space above and below the text (1 is the height of a line)

paddingH.label: Space either side of the text (1 is the height of a line)

borderWidth.label: Outline width in pixels (0 for none)

vAlign.label: Where the panel sits in its box, up and down

textSize.label: Text size: how big the text is in a box 620 pixels wide. It scales up and down with the box, so it looks the same at any size. A goal name too long for its row shrinks to fit.

activeScale.label: Size of the goal being worked on, compared with the text size (the biggest line in the list)

nameWeight.label: Boldness of the goal being worked on

waitingWeight.label: Boldness of goals waiting their turn

waitingScale.label: Size of goals waiting their turn and reached goals, as a percentage of the goal being worked on

strikeDone.label: Strike through the name of a reached goal

textShadow.label: Soft shadow behind the text, to help it read over bright scenes

trackOpacity.label: Empty part of the bar, opacity (0 to 1) (used when the style preset is Custom)

barHeight.label: Bar thickness (1 is the height of a line)

rowGap.label: Space between goals (1 is the height of a line)

showThanks.label: When every goal has been reached, show a thank-you message at the bottom (needs Keep reached goals on screen)

thanksBar.label: Show a full, glowing bar under the message

thanksScale.label: Message size compared with the text size (a long message shrinks to fit)

animate.label: Animate (untick to switch every animation and transition off)

fillSeconds.label: Seconds a bar takes to fill

colorTitle.label: Title colour (used when the style preset is Custom)

colorTotal.label: Sub count colour (used when the style preset is Custom)

colorPanel.label: Panel colour (used when the style preset is Custom)

borderColor.label: Outline colour (used when the style preset is Custom)

cText.label: Text colour for the goal being worked on (used when the style preset is Custom)

colorWaiting.label: Text colour for goals waiting their turn (used when the style preset is Custom)

colorDone.label: Text colour for reached goals (used when the style preset is Custom)

cAccent.label: Progress bar colour (used when the style preset is Custom)

cTrack.label: Empty part of the bar, colour (used when the style preset is Custom)

colorGlow.label: Glow colour when a goal is reached (used when the style preset is Custom)

colorThanks.label: Message colour (used when the style preset is Custom)

btnDemo.label: Add three example goals (5 karaoke, 10 game, 15 chat confessions)

btnTracking.label: Start or stop tracking subs and bits

btnReset.label: Reset the sub count to 0 and re-open every goal

mute.label: Mute every sound (the sound files are kept)

subSound.label: Sound when a sub counts (a gift bomb plays it once). Leave empty for none.

bitsSound.label: Sound when bits are cheered, tips arrive or either is added. Leave empty for none.

goalSound.label: Sound when a goal is reached (once, even if several are reached together). Leave empty for none.

goalReplacesSound.label: When a sub or cheer reaches a goal, play only the goal sound (so the two do not talk over each other)

debug.label: Log each subscriber and cheer event to the browser console (for troubleshooting)
